sources.fullCitation: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique. “René Nazelles.” Musée SACEM, Les créateurs. Author and composer, born in Paris on 8 October 1888, died on 11 September 1975; elected full member of SACEM on 13 September 1911; Prix Salabert, 1958. Accessed 25 August 2026.
sources.title: René Nazelles
sources.researchNote: The register settles the life dates that the BnF heading still gives as an open span, agreeing with the years recorded by the film and record databases, and dates his standing in the society from 1911.
